title: The Rental Booking Paradox
subtitle: Episode 1
logline: Her rental car was confirmed two weeks ago, and the counter has none. The ride that rescues her is the same company's car, and its odometer explains why.
style: Photoreal live-action film frame, contemporary Los Angeles, intimate observational realism, soft natural mixed light, muted warm-neutral palette (warm beige and cream, muted olive and dusty navy accents, soft charcoal shadows), subtle fine film texture, natural skin texture, believable exposure.
avoid: Photoreal live action, not animation, illustration, CGI or a 3D render. No captions, subtitles or watermarks; no real brand logos; no extra people; natural hands and anatomy.
clip_audio: No background music or score: only ambient sound, action sounds and voices.

traveler.name: Traveler
traveler.look: Woman, mid-twenties (she looks about 25, with a youthful face), mixed-heritage American, about 165 cm, slim light athletic build. Oval face with a softly pointed chin, high rounded cheekbones, almond eyes set slightly wide, straight nose with a small rounded tip, full lower lip, straight medium-thick brows. Dark brown-black straight shoulder-length bob, deep side part on the left, front strands tucked behind the right ear. Dark brown eyes. Warm tan skin, a small mole under the left eye; light natural makeup, natural lip color. No glasses, no bangs, no earrings, no jewelry, no tattoos, no hat.
traveler.outfit: a coral-orange lightweight hip-length zip jacket with two side slit pockets, worn open over a plain cream crew-neck T-shirt; dark navy straight-leg trousers; dark charcoal low sneakers
traveler.voice: a clear voice of a woman in her mid-twenties, slightly husky after a long flight
traveler.pose: one hand lightly in a jacket side pocket with the thumb out

clerk.name: Clerk
clerk.look: Man, early thirties, East Asian American, about 175 cm, lean average build. Rectangular face with a flat defined jaw, broad forehead, narrow monolid eyes, low straight brows, medium nose with a wide bridge, thin lips. Black short hair, neatly combed side part on the right, tidy tapered sides. Dark brown eyes. Light olive skin, clean-shaven. No glasses, no beard, no earrings, no tattoos, no hat.
clerk.outfit: a fitted dark navy blazer over a white button-up shirt with a plain dark navy tie, a small yellow square pin with a dark capital H on the left lapel; charcoal slacks; black leather shoes
clerk.voice: a steady, low, unhurried voice of a man in his early thirties who never raises it
clerk.pose: one hand lightly pinching the opposite blazer cuff

driver.name: Driver
driver.look: Man, late forties, Latino American, about 178 cm, solid broad-shouldered build with a slight belly. Round-square face with full cheeks, deep smile lines, heavy-lidded wide-set eyes, broad nose, thick dark brows, neatly trimmed salt-and-pepper mustache. Black hair with grey at the temples, short, combed back. Dark brown eyes. Medium brown sun-weathered skin. No glasses, no sunglasses, no full beard, no earrings, no tattoos, no hat.
driver.outfit: a light blue short-sleeve chambray button shirt, untucked, loose sleeves; dark wash straight jeans with front pockets; tan work sneakers
driver.voice: a warm, relaxed baritone that talks about the car like an old colleague and calls her she
driver.pose: one hand lightly in a front jeans pocket with the thumb out

narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.voice: a crisp, warm voice of a woman in her forties with a hint of a teasing smile, like a clever friend leaning in to explain

sedan.name: The yellow H sedan
sedan.look: A contemporary compact four-door sedan with a low roofline, not an SUV. Warm golden-yellow paint; the roof is sun-faded to a noticeably paler, chalky yellow, clearly visible in the three-quarter view. The same three-box four-door sedan body with a separate trunk in all three panels, never a hatchback. A smooth plain front grille and a plain trunk lid with no emblem, badge or lettering. Blue-grey tinted windows, dark grey alloy wheels, clear headlights, coral-red taillights, blank license plates with no characters, no roof rack, no taxi sign
sedan.marks: one small square H badge (a yellow square with a dark capital H) on the driver-side front door, and nothing else

phone.name: Her phone
phone.look: A contemporary slim slab smartphone. Front: the whole screen is off and blank, thin black bezel, no icons. Back: matte graphite-black body with a single camera bump in the top-left corner, no logo or text. A soft silver metal frame, one side button on the right edge, no case

suitcase.name: The teal suitcase
suitcase.look: A medium teal hard-shell rolling suitcase with vertical ridges, a black telescoping handle and four black spinner wheels, no logo or text

counter.name: Airport Rental Counter
counter.look: The H rental area of a 2020s Los Angeles airport rental center: a long glossy bright-yellow service counter across the middle of the frame; on the wall behind it one large H sign (a yellow square with a dark capital H), the only logo; a black thin-bezel flat monitor at the right end of the counter with a blank screen; a chrome queue stanchion with a navy belt at the front left; a floor-to-ceiling glass wall on the right letting in bright California daylight; a light grey polished floor. Only these fixtures: no other furniture, seats, posters or luggage carts
counter.light: Daytime: bright warm-white daylight slants in from the glass wall on the right, cool white ceiling light fills in, soft reflections on the floor.

curb.name: Airport Curb
curb.look: The arrivals-level pickup curb of a 2020s Los Angeles airport: a wide light concrete sidewalk with the rental center's glass entrance doors behind, with no signs or lettering above them; on the left a row of three tall palm trees in square concrete planters along the curb; on the right two square grey concrete columns holding up the elevated roadway above, shading the right half; in the foreground an empty asphalt pickup lane with white curb markings; no traffic cones, no luggage, no other vehicles
curb.light: Afternoon: hard warm-white California sun from the upper left, crisp palm shadows on the sidewalk, cooler blue shade under the elevated road on the right.

highway.name: California Coastal Highway
highway.look: A two-lane Southern California coastal highway: dark asphalt with a double yellow center line curving gently toward the horizon; the Pacific Ocean and a white metal guardrail on the left; dry golden grass slopes and low coastal bluffs on the right; no other cars, no road signs, no billboards, no buildings
highway.light: Sunset: a low apricot sun just above the sea straight ahead, soft backlight along the road, pale grey-green shadows; soft, never a harsh golden glare.
